notes.title: Zombie Police: The Adventure Continues
notes.content:
How's everyone doing? It's the Zombie Police development team!

We have some exciting news along with today's update.

[b]■ Zombie Police Launches on iOS![/b]

Zombie Police is now available on the App Store! Enjoy the game on your iPhone or iPad.

The iOS version supports multiple languages (Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, and French) from launch. Like the Steam version, it will receive updates with new side stories starting with "Convenience Store Chatter," as well as translation improvements.

  ▼ Download the iOS version here:
https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id6737544859


[b]■ Free Zombie Police Demo Available Now on iOS![/b]

Try the first chapter, "The Namino Hotel Incident," for free! This demo features the same story content as the full iOS and Steam versions, so feel free to check it out before purchasing the full game.

  ▼ Download the free demo here:
https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id6737910745


[b]■ Nintendo Switch Version in Development![/b]

Following the iOS release, we're also developing a Nintendo Switch version! We'll share more details, including the release date, soon.

[b]■ Zombie Police Sequel Announced![/b]

Due to the positive reception of Zombie Police, we're thrilled to announce a sequel is in the works! Stay tuned for more information on the continuing adventures of Zombie Detective Akemi Kabane and her partner, Yasu Tamura.

Thank you for your continued support! We can't wait to share more about the future of Zombie Police!

notes.title: Update Notes (ver.1.01)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is the "Zombie Police" development team.

Today, we have updated "Zombie Police: Christmas Dancing with Police Zombies".
Here are the details:

[b]- System Fix[/b]
Fixed a bug where the text speed would reset to default when restarting the game.

[b]- Performance Improvement[/b]
Implemented measures to address the issue of screen flickering that occurred when clicking in specific scenes.
We will continue to work on improvements to ensure a smooth gaming experience.

[b]- Simplified Chinese Translation Update[/b]
Improved the Simplified Chinese translation to enhance your enjoyment of the story.

[b]- Other Improvements[/b]
Addressed various minor issues and made other improvements.
And we have passed the Steam Deck compatibility check and is now verified to play on Steam Deck.

Added on 9/11
We have again fixed the issue where certain lines were not displaying properly in the Windows version.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

The development team would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to all the players who have played "Zombie Police" since its release and taken the time to leave reviews.
Thank you for your continued support of "Zombie Police".

notes.title: 2024.08.08(JST) on Sale
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is the "Zombie Police" development team.

We're thrilled to announce that [b]"Zombie Police: Christmas Dancing with Police Zombies" will be released on August 8, 2024![/b] (JST)
Additionally, we'll be launching the game's complete soundtrack on the same day.

[h3]Pricing Details[/h3]
- Base Game: $12.99
- Game + Soundtrack Bundle: $16.99
- Soundtrack Only: $6.99

To celebrate our launch, we're offering a [b]25% discount for the first 14 days after release![/b]

[h3]Game Updates[/h3]
We'd like to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who played the demo and shared their feedback. Your input has been invaluable, and we've implemented the following improvements for the full release:

[b]1. Fullscreen Mode[/b]
- Added a fullscreen button to the title screen

[b]2. Audio Adjustments[/b]
- Implemented overall volume control
- Adjusted movie audio to match BGM levels

[b]3. Text Speed Enhancement[/b]
- Increased the maximum text display speed

[b]4. Performance Optimization[/b]
- Improved image processing for better overall performance

We're also enhancing various visual elements and illustrations to make your journey through the world of "Zombie Police" even more immersive.

All recent updates and improvements have already been implemented in the demo version.
Post-release, we plan to update the game with English and Simplified Chinese translations.

[h3]Events & Campaigns[/h3]
We're excited to announce that "Zombie Police" will have a booth at [b]"Kyoto International Manga Anime Fair 2024" on September 21-22![/b]
We'll be selling original merchandise, so we hope to see you there!

A huge thank you to everyone who participated in our [Zombie Police: Demo Campaign] in June.
Winners will be notified via email or DM before the game's release date.

Thank you for your continued support of "Zombie Police".
We can't wait for you to experience the full game!

notes.title: Zombie Police News #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the "Zombie Police" development team.
We are thrilled to bring you our first announcement.
[h3]Latest News[/h3]
We would like to express our gratitude for the overwhelming response we received when we released information about "Zombie Police" on April 19th at 12:00 a.m. Japan time.
As announced, "Zombie Police: Christmas Dancing with Police Zombies" is scheduled for release in the summer of 2024.
Additionally, we are planning to start the [b]free distribution of Chapter 1, "The Namino Hotel Fall Case," during the Steam Next Fest in June[/b].
We will put even more effort into development to meet your expectations.
[h3]About the event, "The CREATORS"[/h3]
At "The CREATORS," a creator exchange event held in Akihabara on April 19th and 20th, we exhibited a trial version of "Zombie Police."
We received a lot of positive feedback and support from many people who played the game.
Thank you to everyone who came to the event.
[h3]About the "Zombie Police" Trial Version Video[/h3]
[b]In the near future, we will release a video of the trial version content[/b] exhibited at "The CREATORS."
You can check out the actual game screens and story in this video. Please look forward to it.
[h3]Future Information Releases[/h3]
We plan to release more information leading up to the Steam Next Fest scheduled for June.
To avoid missing the latest news, please follow our official SNS accounts on X, Bluesky, and other platforms.
Don't forget to add us to your wishlist on Steam!

We appreciate your continued support for "Zombie Police."
